title: Set a controller response header
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Set a controller response header. Inspect the Cache-Control header.
introduction: A controller can set response metadata before returning a result. Open GET /note.
learningObjectives: Set a controller response header with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Set a controller response header

blocks.text: The action sets its header before calling Ok. The body still contains only the note field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Headers must be set before the response starts.
